n16f52d3a56.headline: Oracle May Cut Up To 30,000 Jobs To Fund Massive AI Data-Centre Expansion: Report
n16f52d3a56.summary: Oracle plans to cut 20,000 to 30,000 jobs and sell parts of its business to help fund a $156 billion AI data-centre expansion, according to a report. The company is reportedly seeking $45-50 billion in 2026 for cloud capacity growth amid financing challenges.
n16f52d3a56.why: Oracle is a major enterprise software and cloud infrastructure provider, and its heavy AI data-centre spending and funding strategy are closely watched by investors.

impacts.name: Oracle
impacts.why: The reported job cuts and asset sales are Oracle's own measures to fund its AI data-centre spending.

n16f52d3a56.why_moved: The report points to financing pressure from pulled-back bank lending and a large AI data-centre build-out, which may prompt investors to reassess Oracle's funding and cash flow.

n29bf1cff48.headline: Malawi: Weather Experts Warn of Punishing Dry Spell As Southern Malawi Stares At Looming Food Crisis
n29bf1cff48.summary: Weather experts warn that a punishing dry spell is tightening its grip on southern Malawi. They raise fears of a food security and economic crisis that could affect millions of people.
n29bf1cff48.why: Drought-driven crop losses in a largely agricultural economy can push up food prices, strain government finances and affect regional agricultural commodity supply.

ncff0c0017b.headline: NAPCO Security Technologies Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
ncff0c0017b.summary: NAPCO Security Technologies executives highlighted record fiscal second-quarter 2026 revenue, expanding margins and continued growth in recurring service revenue during an earnings call on Monday.
ncff0c0017b.why: NAPCO is a US maker of security and access-control products, and its recurring service revenue and margin trends are key indicators for investors in the security technology sector.

n4b0c8dada8.headline: Africa Poised to Outgrow Asia for First Time Amid Youth Boom
n4b0c8dada8.summary: IMF figures suggest Africa's growth could outpace Asia's for the first time in 2026, as the continent's population continues to rise rapidly.
n4b0c8dada8.why: The IMF publishes global growth forecasts that guide investor expectations for emerging-market regions.

n043111bb20.headline: Markets Today: Euro Zone output rebounds, gold and silver extend slide, FTSE 100 resilient
n043111bb20.summary: Gold and silver extended losses while tech stocks fell, as the nomination of Warsh boosted the dollar. Euro zone output rebounded and the FTSE 100 remained resilient.
n043111bb20.why: Gold and silver are traditional stores of value that often move against the US dollar and real interest-rate expectations.

n153adebe8b.headline: Saudi Arabia Funds $40 Million Industrial City Project in Oman
n153adebe8b.summary: The Saudi Fund for Development and Oman's Ministry of Finance signed an MoU to fund an industrial city in Dhofar with $40 million. The project aims to develop industrial and logistics sectors.
n153adebe8b.why: The Saudi Fund for Development is a Saudi state lender that finances infrastructure projects in other countries.

n3f8ab01ca3.headline: Iran President Orders Talks with US as Trump Hopeful of Deal
n3f8ab01ca3.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has ordered the start of nuclear talks with the United States, local media said. Trump said he was hopeful of a deal to avert military action.
n3f8ab01ca3.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and Middle East tensions and sanctions talks can affect crude prices, shipping risk and regional energy supply. Investors watch these negotiations for their effect on energy markets and risk sentiment.

n49dbb7c1cc.headline: Oracle shares gain as $50 billion raise eases data-center funding fears
n49dbb7c1cc.summary: Oracle shares gained 2% after Wall Street analysts said its $50 billion fundraising plan allays worries about financing a large data-centre expansion with OpenAI.
n49dbb7c1cc.why: Oracle is a major enterprise software and cloud company, and its data-centre buildout for AI customers such as OpenAI is closely watched for capital needs and financing risk.

nb5aae7c105.headline: Atlantic See LNG Trade (Aktor, DEPA Commercial) sign agreement for the sale of US LNG to Ukraine
nb5aae7c105.summary: Aktor and DEPA Commercial signed an agreement on January 30 to supply US LNG to Ukraine. BP is the supplier and Naftogaz of Ukraine the buyer, marking the start of Atlantic See LNG.
nb5aae7c105.why: LNG supply deals determine how gas reaches importing countries and shape regional energy security. BP is a major global energy producer and LNG trader.

n47615eb15a.headline: Marri Retail Files IPO Papers; Aims To Raise ₹522-Crore Via Fresh Issue Of Shares
n47615eb15a.summary: Hyderabad-based apparel and jewellery retailer Marri Retail has filed preliminary IPO papers with SEBI to raise Rs 522 crore via fresh shares and promoter stake sale, reporting Rs 1,301 crore H1 FY26 revenue.
n47615eb15a.why: Marri Retail is an Indian apparel and jewellery retailer, and its listing would add a new consumer stock to the Indian market.

nc4a3534334.headline: IBEX 35 Breaks 18,000 Mark for the First Time Despite Global Market Jitters
nc4a3534334.summary: The Madrid-based IBEX 35 closed above the 18,000-point threshold for the first time in its history on Monday, defying falling commodity prices that weighed on investor sentiment.
nc4a3534334.why: The IBEX 35 is Spain's benchmark stock index, tracking the country's largest listed companies across banking, utilities and energy.

impacts.name: IBEX 35
impacts.why: The benchmark index reached a record closing level above 18,000 points.

n4f6b5181e4.headline: UAE’s non-oil exports catching up with Saudi Arabia
n4f6b5181e4.summary: UAE non-oil trade passed the $1 trillion mark for the first time, according to Dubai ruler Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum. The report compares the UAE's non-oil exports with Saudi Arabia's.
n4f6b5181e4.why: Non-oil trade reflects diversification of the UAE economy away from hydrocarbons, a key factor in the Gulf's long-term growth outlook.

na1fee130b8.headline: SpaceX acquires xAI as Musk looks to unify ambitions
na1fee130b8.summary: Elon Musk says he is merging SpaceX with his artificial-intelligence company xAI, a move aimed at unifying the two businesses' ambitions.
na1fee130b8.why: SpaceX is a private rocket and satellite company, and xAI develops AI models such as Grok. A combination would link launch and satellite operations with AI development.

n603b6a9416.headline: Global grain glut pushes growers toward self-storage
n603b6a9416.summary: A global oversupply of grain continues to weigh on the earnings of one of Australia's biggest grain handlers.
n603b6a9416.why: GrainCorp is one of Australia's largest grain handlers and exporters, so its earnings track global grain prices and volumes.

n02ab08b066.headline: Miners drag bourse lower as gold loses its shine
n02ab08b066.summary: A sharp sell-off in gold and silver weighed on the Australian bourse amid a broader pullback in basic materials. Miners dragged the market lower.
n02ab08b066.why: Australian miners are major producers of gold and base metals, so the sector's moves shape the local index and commodity export earnings.
n02ab08b066.why_moved: A sharp sell-off in gold and silver, alongside a broader pullback in basic materials, weighed on the market and miners.

nd707fd618a.headline: EV transition had ‘pronounced impact’ on used values in 2025
nd707fd618a.summary: The UK car market's shift toward electrification accelerated in 2025, with a pronounced impact on used values. Used EV prices came under significant pressure, while new OEM entrants gained opportunities.
nd707fd618a.why: Used car values affect vehicle leasing residuals and the finance providers that depend on them, making them relevant to automakers and lenders.

n58ef75d099.headline: Stock Market Today, Feb. 2: Apple Stock Jumps After Record Q1 Revenue Boosts Investor Confidence
n58ef75d099.summary: Apple stock jumped after record holiday iPhone sales, surging services revenue and new AI moves drew investor attention. The update covers the February 2, 2026 trading session.
n58ef75d099.why: Apple is one of the largest companies in the S&P 500, so its quarterly results and product demand heavily influence index performance and tech-sector sentiment.

n07c502bce1.summary: Nio stock fell after its January deliveries raised concerns about demand for Chinese electric vehicles. Investors weighed strong delivery volumes against doubts about demand, margins and model concentration.

n612d2db4b1.headline: Aptiv Q4 Earnings Call Highlights
n612d2db4b1.summary: Aptiv reported record fourth-quarter revenue and set out its 2026 outlook on its Q4 2025 earnings call. It also highlighted preparations for a planned April 1 spinoff of its Electrical Distribution Systems business.
n612d2db4b1.why: Aptiv is a major automotive components supplier, so its results and portfolio changes signal conditions across global car production.

nbcea5c5055.headline: Korean conglomerates pay college graduates far more than Japan, Taiwan: study
nbcea5c5055.summary: College graduates joining South Korea's conglomerates start with higher pay than peers in Japan and Taiwan, with the gap widening sharply as careers progress. The study was reported by The Korea Herald.
nbcea5c5055.why: Conglomerates, or chaebol, dominate South Korea's economy, so their pay levels shape labor costs and talent competition across the market.

n6d37208ada.summary: Gold fell after its biggest plunge in more than a decade, while silver whipsawed in choppy trading following a dramatic reversal of a record-breaking rally that ran too far, too fast.
n6d37208ada.why: Gold and silver are widely held as safe-haven and inflation hedge assets, and their prices affect mining companies, jewellers and portfolio allocations.

naae5377715.headline: Seoul stocks slide over 5% as Warsh Fed pick rattles global markets
naae5377715.summary: Seoul stocks tumbled more than 5% as global markets reeled from Donald Trump's announcement of Kevin Warsh as the next Federal Reserve chair.
naae5377715.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, and its leadership influences global capital flows and asset prices, including in Korea.
naae5377715.why_moved: Global markets reacted to the announcement of Kevin Warsh as the next Federal Reserve chair, prompting a broad sell-off.

n1012d22530.headline: Sensex, Nifty in green despite negative global cues
n1012d22530.summary: Indian equity markets traded higher early on Monday, recovering some of the previous losses despite negative global cues.
n1012d22530.why: The Sensex and Nifty 50 are the benchmark indexes of Indian equities, tracking the largest listed companies on the Bombay and National stock exchanges.

n9deb6ae5a3.headline: LG has stopped making 8K TVs
n9deb6ae5a3.summary: LG has stopped manufacturing 8K televisions. The company left the door open to returning to the business should market conditions improve.
n9deb6ae5a3.why: LG Electronics is a South Korea-based consumer electronics and display maker, and its TV line is a significant part of its revenue. Changes in its product lineup can signal demand trends in premium TV segments.

n3fb00ca799.headline: PM Shehbaz, World Bank President Strengthen Ties for Develop
n3fb00ca799.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz and World Bank President Banga pledged closer cooperation and economic reforms to support Pakistan's development.
n3fb00ca799.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender that provides financing and policy support to developing economies. Its engagement with Pakistan can affect the country's funding and reform agenda.

nb9f1c0ea90.headline: 93 Countries Worldwide at Risk of Losing Nearly 23 Million More People by 2030
nb9f1c0ea90.summary: A study supported by the Rockefeller Foundation warns that severe global aid cuts could cause nearly 23 million people to be lost in 93 countries by 2030.
nb9f1c0ea90.why: Aid reductions can severely impact economic development and stability in vulnerable countries, affecting global economic growth and markets.
